summary: Inter & Co, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2025 annual report (annual report for the year ended December 31, 2025) to the SEC as a foreign private issuer. The report summarizes the company's financial and operational performance for 2025, with no mention of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. The filing is a routine annual report submission and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
